question: The position vectors of points $P$ and $Q$ are $2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-\hat{k}$ and $-\hat{i}+5\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$, respectively. Find $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ and verify that $\overrightarrow{QP}=-\overrightarrow{PQ}$.
explanation:
Step 1: Vector directed from $P$ to $Q$
Using $\overrightarrow{PQ}=\overrightarrow{OQ}-\overrightarrow{OP}$,
\(\overrightarrow{PQ}=(-\hat{i}+5\hat{j}+4\hat{k})-(2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-\hat{k})\)
Thus,
\(\overrightarrow{PQ}=-3\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+5\hat{k}\)
Step 2: Vector directed from $Q$ to $P$
\(\overrightarrow{QP}=\overrightarrow{OP}-\overrightarrow{OQ}=3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}-5\hat{k}\)
Step 3: Comparison of the two vectors
Taking the negative of $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ gives
\(-\overrightarrow{PQ}=3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}-5\hat{k}=\overrightarrow{QP}\)
Final Answer
$\overrightarrow{PQ}=-3\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+5\hat{k}$ and $\overrightarrow{QP}=-\overrightarrow{PQ}$.
